## `api/v1/views.py`
- Imported `delete_tenant_task`.
- Added a `destroy` method to `TenantViewSet` that dispatches `delete_tenant_task.apply_async(kwargs={"tenant_id": tenant_id})` and immediately returns `204 No Content`, keeping the API responsive while cleanup runs asynchronously.

All three files compile cleanly, and I left the `tests/` directory untouched.
